text: The paper reports that its approach substantially improves classification over the baseline from 71% to 98% correct (p=0.0004). Reviewing the ICE execution traces showed the gain came almost entirely from answering based on each paragraph, not from answering based on trial arms; whenever the arms-based classification tentatively classified a trial arm as a placebo, it also found that participants might be able to tell which arm they were in, and so ultimately said it was unclear whether there was a placebo.
title: Placebo classification improves from 71% to 98% via paragraph-wise decomposition
